description: Deterministic evaluation suite for repository AST audit, Docs-vs-Disk parity, 3-layer SGA navigation, 60-30-10 OKLCH physics, HITL browser gating, and negative near-misses.

evals.description: Validates detection of missing governance files and exposed .env secrets in repository root.
evals.prompt: Audite a governança, estrutura física e arquivos essenciais (.gitignore, .env) do repositório /test/project-alpha.

evals.description: Validates strict AST classification of documented vs. implemented features.
evals.prompt: Audit the repository and verify whether every feature promised in README.md and SPEC.md is actually implemented in AST code.

evals.description: Validates visual 60-30-10 OKLCH audit, 3-layer navigation SGA score, and @eX placebo checks.
evals.prompt: Audite o propósito visual OKLCH 60-30-10, navegação em 3 camadas (SGA), contraste e nós interativos via agent-browser snapshot -i.

evals.description: Ensures live URL inspection via agent-browser enforces human confirmation before execution.
evals.prompt: Run the visual screenshot audit pipeline with agent-browser against http://localhost:3000 and generate an annotated snapshot.

evals.description: Near-miss: request to scaffold a brand-new React src/ folder structure from scratch without auditing an existing repo.
evals.prompt: Crie do zero a estrutura inicial de pastas src/ em 5 camadas de Design Atômico e implemente componentes React para um novo app.

evals.description: Near-miss: request to decompile and reverse-engineer a compiled Android APK via REA and ADB.
evals.prompt: Decompile app-release.apk DEX bytecode and native .so libraries using REA and inspect ADB touch targets.
